1.text: Uwiteka, igitare cyanjye ahimbazwe,Wigishe amaboko yanjye kurasana,N'intoki zanjye kurwana.

2.text: Ni we mboneramo imbabazi,Kandi ni igihome kinkingira.Ni igihome kirekire kinkingira n'umukiza wanjye,Ni ingabo inkingira n'uwo niringira,Ni we ungomōrera ubwoko bwanjye ngo mbutegeke.

3.text: Uwiteka, umuntu ni iki ko umumenya?Cyangwa umwana w'umuntu ko umwitaho?

4.text: Umuntu ameze nk'umwuka gusa,Iminsi ye imeze nk'igicucu gishira.

5.text: Uwiteka, manura ijuru ryawe umanuke,Ukore ku misozi iracumba.

7.text: Urambure ukuboko kwawe uri mu ijuru,Undohōre unkure mu mazi y'isanzure,Unkize amaboko y'abanyamahanga.

8.text: Akanwa kabo kavuga ibitagira umumaro,N'ukuboko kwabo kw'iburyo ni ukuboko kw'ibinyoma.

9.text: Mana, ndakuririmbira indirimbo nshya,Ndakuririmbira ishimwe kuri nebelu y'imirya cumi.

10.text: Ni we uha abami agakiza,Ukiza Dawidi umugaragu we inkota yica.

11.text: Nyarura unkure mu maboko y'abanyamahanga,Akanwa kabo kavuga ibitagira umumaro,Ukuboko kwabo kw'iburyo ni ukuboko kw'ibinyoma.

12.text: Kugira ngo abahungu bacu babe nk'ibiti byikuririza,Bakiri abasore.N'abakobwa bacu bamere nk'amabuye akomeza impfuruka,Abajwe nk'uko babaza amabuye arimbisha inyumba.

13.text: Ngo ibigega byacu byuzure,Birimo imyaka y'imbuto zose,Intama zacu zibyarire ibihumbi n'inzovu mu rwuri rwacu.

14.text: Ngo amapfizi yacu agire imitwaro iremereye,Ngo he kugira abatwaranira mu byuho,Cyangwa abasohoka kurwana.Kandi mu nzira zacu he kuba umuborogo.

15.text: Hahirwa ubwoko bumera butyo,Hahirwa ubwoko bufite Uwiteka ho Imana yabwo.
